events.title: Members Artwork Drop Off Final Day
events.description: Calling all artists! You’re invited to enter RoCo’s Annual Members Exhibition. We invite artists from the Rochester region and beyond to enter one artwork and participate in this diverse and eclectic exhibition. All entries will be exhibited and eligible for numerous cash awards. Not a member yet? Join here. Artwork Drop off Days: Thursday November 5, 12-5pm Friday November 6, 12-9pm Saturday November 7, 12-5pm GUIDELINES • Each artist is limited to one piece maximum of 2D: 32” x 32” / 3D: 24” x 24” x 24" • Artwork must be delivered ready to hang, framed and wired. • Please contact RoCo Staff by October 1 to make arrangements for video artworks. The post Members Artwork Drop Off Final Day appeared first on Rochester Contemporary Art Center (RoCo).

events.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
events.description: OPENS SEPT. 25 | Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

events.title: You Had to Be There
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 25 | A documentary about the legendary 1972 Toronto production of the musical about the life of Jesus, which launched many illustrious careers and ignited a comedy revolution.

events.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 18 | On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with mad science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

events.title: Primetime
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 25 | In 2006, "To Catch a Predator" host Chris Hansen (Robert Pattinson) sets out to make television history.

events.title: Trash Plate Trivia at Dragonfly
events.description: Garbage-plate rounds, cheap pitchers, bragging rights.

events.title: Special Needs Revolt! – Oct. 1
events.description: SPECIAL SCREENING | Thursday, October 1 at 7:30pm | In a future dystopia, a man with Down syndrome joins a rebellion against America's cruel dictator who has put all people with disabilities back into institutions. It's up to Billy and his rebels to save America and end Kruger's reign of terror! Includes a Q&A with local filmmaker Adrian Esposito.

events.title: AngstLAB, $3 cover, drink specials all night
events.description: Goth/industrial night. Cheap wells until last call.
